vanguard_basic.name: Shield Bash
vanguard_basic.desc: Quick shield strike. Landing it lets you cancel into Ground Breaker or Retaliate.

ground_breaker.name: Ground Breaker
ground_breaker.desc: Smash the ground: launches enemies and sends a shockwave.
ground_breaker.tip: Hit them as they jump or approach.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.desc: Spend ALL Bulwark: damage grows with the amount spent (up to +24).
retaliate.tip: Wait until Bulwark is high. Needs 30.

shield_rush.name: Shield Rush
shield_rush.desc: Charge forward with the shield raised, knocking enemies back.
shield_rush.tip: Close the gap or escape pressure.

bastion.name: Titan's Bastion
bastion.desc: Shield yourself AND nearby allies (-60% damage, 4s) and blast nearby enemies away.
bastion.tip: Use when your team is being pressured.

duelist_basic.name: Rapier Thrust
duelist_basic.desc: Fast thrust. Each hit builds Momentum.
duelist_basic.tip: Chain into Quick Slash when it connects.

quick_slash.name: Quick Slash
quick_slash.desc: Three rapid slashes. Great for stacking Momentum.

phantom_step.name: Phantom Step
phantom_step.desc: Dash through enemies; your next hit deals x1.8. With 3+ Momentum, Quick Slash is refunded.
phantom_step.tip: Cross up an enemy, then punish.

sidestep.name: Sidestep
sidestep.desc: Short invulnerable step. Can cancel any attack's recovery.

thousand_cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand_cuts.desc: Blink to the nearest enemy and cut eight times. Consumes your Momentum bonus into the finishing blow.
thousand_cuts.tip: Use it on a staggered enemy.

ranger_basic.name: Arrow
ranger_basic.desc: Quick arrow. Stand still 0.7s first for +50% damage.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.desc: Heavy arrow that pierces up to 5 targets.

hunters_mark.name: Hunter's Mark
hunters_mark.desc: Mark an enemy for 6s: your damage to them is +25% and your ultimate charges faster.

shadow_dash.name: Shadow Dash
shadow_dash.desc: Leap backwards with brief invulnerability and gain speed.

arrow_storm.name: Arrow Storm
arrow_storm.desc: Rain arrows over the target for 10 volleys. Marked enemies take +25%.
arrow_storm.tip: Enemies can simply walk out - zone them in.

explosive_round.name: Explosive Round
explosive_round.desc: Slow shell that explodes on contact. Costs 2 rounds.

dead_eye.name: Dead Eye
dead_eye.desc: Fire a six-bullet fan. For 5s you have infinite ammo and +25% damage.
dead_eye.tip: Open with the fan, then unload.

arcanist_basic.name: Elemental Orb
arcanist_basic.desc: Orb of the attuned element. Costs 6 mana.
arcanist_basic.tip: Frost slows, Fire burns, Storm chains.

arcane_bolt.name: Arcane Bolt
arcane_bolt.desc: Homing bolt of the attuned element. Costs 18 mana.
arcane_bolt.tip: Frost first, then Fire bolt to Shatter.

attune.name: Attune
attune.desc: Cycle element: Fire (+20% dmg), Frost (slows), Storm (chains). Fire on a slowed enemy = Shatter x1.5.

cataclysm.name: Cataclysm
cataclysm.desc: A colossal meteor crashes on the target after a long warning, slowing survivors.
cataclysm.tip: Slow them first so they cannot leave.

shadeweaver_basic.name: Void Lash
shadeweaver_basic.desc: Scythe sweep. Damage grows with Shadow (up to +40%).
shadeweaver_basic.tip: Stay moving to keep Shadow high.

binding_chains.name: Binding Chains
binding_chains.desc: Chains that root the target for 1.4s. Rooted foes are then immune to roots for 2.5s.

shadow_echo.name: Shadow Echo
shadow_echo.desc: Teleport forward, leaving an echo. Press again within 3s to swap back. An unused echo bursts when it fades.

rift_blink.name: Rift Blink
rift_blink.desc: Blink through the Rift and burst on exit. Gives +10 Shadow.

eclipse.name: Eclipse
eclipse.desc: A wave of darkness roots every enemy nearby for 1.3s after a clear wind-up.
eclipse.tip: Hit them while they are rooted.
